plan: Land at Chiang Mai airport (one-stop flight from Cairo) and take a 15-minute taxi to U Chiang Mai on Ratchadamnoen Road in the old city. After a rest, walk to Wat Phra Singh next door and the great ruined chedi of Wat Chedi Luang, then take a Grab to the Night Bazaar and Anusarn market for khao soi and mango sticky rice. Cool evenings, about 17 °C, so bring a light jacket.
romantic: Candle-lit dinner at a riverside restaurant on the Ping River, a short walk from the Night Bazaar.

plan: Ethical elephant morning at Elephant Nature Park (half-day programme with pickup, no riding and no bathing: you feed the elephants and walk with them as they roam), back by early afternoon. Evening at the Saturday Night Walking Street on Wualai Road for street food and crafts, with Wat Sri Suphan, the silver temple, on the same street. No swim.
romantic: A couples Lanna massage after the elephants, then the silver temple glowing at night.

plan: Morning Thai cooking class at an organic farm outside the city: market visit, pick herbs in the garden and cook five dishes (pickup included, lunch is what you cook). Late afternoon red songthaew up to Wat Phra That Doi Suthep and its golden chedi above the city. Evening at the Sunday Walking Street, Chiang Mai’s biggest night market, which runs along Ratchadamnoen Road right outside the hotel. No swim.
romantic: Sunset over Chiang Mai from the Doi Suthep temple terrace.

plan: Adventure day at Pongyang Jungle Coaster and Zipline in Mae Rim, about 40 minutes away with hotel transfers: the long jungle coaster and the 34-platform zipline course through the forest. Back by mid-afternoon to rest and pack. Evening khantoke dinner with Lanna dances at the Old Chiang Mai Cultural Center. No swim.
romantic: Khantoke dinner by candlelight with Lanna dance and music.

plan: Swims allowed from today (the hotel pool is there if you want it). Morning flight Chiang Mai to Bangkok (about 1 hour 15 minutes) and check in at Hilton Garden Inn Bangkok Riverside. Afternoon cross-river ferry to Wat Arun, then a Grab to Rajadamnern Stadium for an evening of live Muay Thai.
romantic: Wat Arun at sunset from the riverside, with the spires lighting up across the water.

plan: Dream World theme park in Pathum Thani (Grab, about 45 minutes): roller coasters, the Grand Canyon water ride, Snow Town and the Fantasy Land castle. Back in the city for the evening and a street-food dinner.
romantic: Watch the city lights come on from the glass floor of Mahanakhon SkyWalk.

plan: Grand Palace and the Emerald Buddha at the 8:30 opening, then the Reclining Buddha at Wat Pho, a short walk away. Rest in the afternoon, then an early dinner and the countdown on the riverfront beside ICONSIAM, Bangkok’s main New Year spot.
romantic: Midnight fireworks over the Chao Phraya, watched from the ICONSIAM riverside terrace.

plan: Half-day tour to the Maeklong railway market, where the stalls fold back as the train passes, and the Damnoen Saduak floating market by longtail boat (hotel pickup). Afternoon rest, then an evening street-food walk on Yaowarat in Chinatown. Pack for the flight home on 2 Jan (airport Grab costed here).
romantic: A tuk-tuk ride together under the neon signs of Yaowarat Road to close the trip.

plan: Land at Hanoi Noi Bai after the overnight flight via Doha or Dubai and take the hotel car to La Siesta Classic Ma May in the Old Quarter. Cool, about 14 to 21 °C, so bring a light jacket. After a rest, walk around Hoan Kiem Lake to the red Huc Bridge and Ngoc Son Temple, then the Christmas lights at St Joseph’s Cathedral. Evening Old Quarter street food walking tour: pho, bun cha, banh mi and egg coffee.
romantic: Egg coffee on a balcony above Hoan Kiem Lake, then Christmas night at the lit-up St Joseph’s Cathedral.

plan: Ha Long Bay day cruise by limousine van (about 2 hours 30 minutes each way, pickup about 7:30, back about 19:30): seafood lunch on board, Sung Sot Cave, the climb to the Ti Top Island viewpoint, and a kayak or bamboo boat through Luon Cave (no swim). The bay is often misty and about 15 to 20 °C in late December, so bring a warm layer for the top deck.
romantic: The view over the limestone islands from the top of Ti Top Island together.

plan: Ninh Binh day tour by van (about 2 hours each way): the old capital Hoa Lu, a rowing-boat ride through the Trang An caves and rice fields (no swim), cycling between the villages, and the 500 steps up Mua Cave to the dragon viewpoint over Tam Coc. Back in Hanoi for a light dinner.
romantic: Sunset over the Tam Coc rice fields from the dragon on top of Mua Cave.

plan: Morning market visit and cooking class at a villa (pickup from the hotel, lunch is what you cook). Afternoon at the Temple of Literature and Hoa Lo Prison, then coffee on Train Street (the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum is closed on Mondays). Evening water puppet show at the Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre beside Hoan Kiem Lake.
romantic: Cocktails at a rooftop bar over Hoan Kiem Lake after the puppet show.

plan: Morning flight Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City (about 2 hours 10 minutes), Grab to Silverland Sakyo in District 1. Warm again, about 24 to 32 °C. Independence Palace and the War Remnants Museum, then the first swim in the hotel pool. In the evening, the XO Foodie Tour by motorbike picks you up at the hotel.
romantic: Nightcap at the Saigon Saigon Rooftop Bar at the Caravelle, a short walk from the hotel.

plan: Half-day Cu Chi Tunnels tour in the morning: crawl through the wartime tunnels and see the hidden kitchens and traps (back about 13:30). In the afternoon, race go-karts at TGC Speedway in The Global City, with a two-seat kart option.
romantic: Riverside dinner on the wooden deck of The Deck Saigon in Thao Dien, ten minutes from the track.

plan: Slow morning with a swim in the hotel pool to rest for the late night. Lunch in Ben Thanh Market, then a photo stop at the pink Tan Dinh Church. AO Show bamboo circus at the Saigon Opera House at 18:00, then an early dinner nearby.
romantic: Countdown on Nguyen Hue Walking Street, with midnight fireworks over the Saigon River.

plan: Mekong Delta day tour to My Tho and Ben Tre (about 1 hour 30 minutes each way, back about 17:00): boat on the Mekong, a rowing sampan through the coconut canals, coconut-candy workshop, a bicycle ride and lunch in an orchard. Pack for the flight home on 2 Jan (airport Grab costed here).
romantic: Saigon Princess dinner cruise on the Saigon River on the first evening of the year.

plan: Land at Penang airport (one stop via Doha or Dubai) and take a Grab to JEN Penang Georgetown by Shangri-La beside Komtar, about 30 minutes. After a rest, walk the George Town street-art trail: Armenian Street, the ‘Kids on Bicycle’ mural and the steel-rod cartoons, then the lanes of Little India. Evening street food on Kimberley Street and Chulia Street.
romantic: Christmas dinner at a Nyonya (Peranakan) restaurant in a restored shophouse, then a trishaw ride through the lit-up heritage streets.

plan: Malay and Nyonya cooking class with a wet-market tour at Nazlina Spice Station in George Town, 8 am to about 1 pm, lunch is what you cook. Late afternoon, Grab to the Penang Hill funicular (about 25 minutes), ride to the top at 821 m, walk the viewpoints and stay for the city lights (skip The Habitat forest trail).
romantic: Sunset and the lights of George Town and the bridges from the Penang Hill viewpoint, then dinner at David Brown’s on the hill.

plan: Morning at the Chew Jetty clan jetties on stilts over the water, then breakfast-style hawker lunch. 2 pm guided tour of the Cheong Fatt Tze Blue Mansion (tours run Friday to Sunday). Late afternoon at The TOP in Komtar: the Rainbow Skywalk glass ledge on the 68th floor and the observatory.
romantic: Sunset from the Rainbow Skywalk, then seafood and satay at Gurney Drive hawker centre by the sea.

plan: ESCAPE Penang adventure park in Teluk Bahang, about 40 minutes by Grab: ziplines, the ropes course, the giant swing and the long tube slide on dry land (skip the Waterplay zone, no swim). Late afternoon walk on Batu Ferringhi beach (no swim), then the Batu Ferringhi night market.
romantic: Sunset seafood dinner on the sand at Batu Ferringhi.

plan: Morning flight Penang to Kuala Lumpur, about 1 hour, and a Grab to Traders Hotel beside KLCC Park. Swim in the Traders pool now that the no-swim days are over, then Aquaria KLCC aquarium, a short walk away. Evening street food on Jalan Alor in Bukit Bintang.
romantic: Sunset drinks at SkyBar, the pool bar at the top of Traders Hotel facing the Petronas Towers.

plan: Day trip to Genting Highlands, about 1 hour by Grab to the Awana SkyWay station, then the cable car up through the rainforest to 1,800 m (cool, about 15 to 23 °C, bring a light jacket). Genting SkyWorlds theme park all day: Rio, Ice Age, Night at the Museum and Planet of the Apes themed rides and the Lightning Rollercoaster. Grab back in the evening.
romantic: Cable car ride down above the clouds at dusk, then the KLCC Lake Symphony fountain show at 9 or 10 pm.

plan: Early Petronas Towers Skybridge and Observation Deck slot (book online). Grab to Merdeka Square and the Sultan Abdul Samad Building, then Central Market for batik and crafts and lunch on Petaling Street. Couples massage in Bukit Bintang in the afternoon to rest before the night out.
romantic: New Year’s Eve dinner near KLCC, then the countdown and fireworks over the Petronas Towers from the KLCC Park Esplanade, a short walk from the hotel.

plan: Half-day white-water rafting on the Selangor River at Kuala Kubu Bharu, about 1 hour away by car, with lunch (grade 2 to 4 rapids, a guide steers each raft; confirm the 1 January trip when booking). Evening shopping in Pavilion and Bukit Bintang. Pack for the flight home on 2 Jan (the KLIA transfer is costed here).
romantic: Farewell dinner at a rooftop restaurant with a view of the Petronas Towers and KL Tower.

plan: Land in Manila on the overnight flight and connect to Bohol-Panglao (about 1 hour 20 minutes; allow 3 hours, and note the terminal change at Manila airport). Van to The Bellevue Resort on Panglao and rest. Late afternoon, walk Alona Beach and its lanes of small bars and grills (beach walk only, no swim).
romantic: Christmas dinner of grilled seafood on the sand at Alona Beach, with the sunset over the water.

plan: Bohol countryside day by shared tour: Baclayon church, the Philippine Tarsier Sanctuary in Corella (tiny nocturnal primates, quiet viewing, no flash), the Bilar man-made mahogany forest, a floating buffet lunch on the Loboc River, then the Chocolate Hills viewpoint and an ATV ride through the hills. All on land or on the river boat, no swim.
romantic: Floating lunch on the Loboc River, with a local band serenading the boat.

plan: Private car to Danao Adventure Park (EAT Danao, about 2 hours inland): The Plunge canyon swing over the Wahig River gorge, the Suislide zipline and the Sky Ride, all in harness and dry (no swim). Back to Panglao by late afternoon.
romantic: Sunset dinner on the cliff at Bohol Bee Farm, overlooking the sea.

plan: Morning OceanJet fast ferry from Tagbilaran to Cebu City (about 2 hours), taxi to Seda Ayala Center Cebu. Afternoon by taxi through old Cebu: Magellan’s Cross, the Basilica del Santo Niño, Fort San Pedro and Carbon Market, then up to the Temple of Leah and Tops Lookout. No swim.
romantic: City lights from Tops Lookout after sunset, then a lechon dinner (Cebu’s famous roast pig).

plan: The big adventure day and the first swim day: shared tour leaving about 4:00 to the south-west coast. Snorkel with the Moalboal sardine run and sea turtles off Panagsama Beach, then canyoneering down Kawasan’s turquoise canyon in Badian (helmet, life jacket and guide; cliff jumps are optional), ending at Kawasan Falls. Back in Cebu City in the evening.
romantic: A swim together in the blue pool under Kawasan Falls at the end of the canyon.

plan: Early flight Cebu to Manila (about 1 hour 20 minutes), car to Seda Bonifacio Global City to leave bags. Lunchtime Binondo food walk in the world’s oldest Chinatown: dumplings, hopia, fried siopao and lumpia at small family places. 30 Dec is Rizal Day, a public holiday, so expect crowds. Evening back in BGC.
romantic: Sunset over Manila Bay from the Baywalk on the way back from Binondo, then dinner on Bonifacio High Street.

plan: Morning bamboo-bike tour of Intramuros, the old walled city (Fort Santiago, San Agustin Church, Manila Cathedral, the walls); confirm the 31 Dec slot with Bambike. Afternoon rest at the hotel. New Year’s Eve in Bonifacio Global City: dinner nearby, then the free street countdown on Fifth Avenue at Bonifacio High Street with big screens, live music and fireworks at midnight.
romantic: Midnight fireworks over Bonifacio High Street, with the whole city setting off its own fireworks around you.

plan: Slow New Year’s Day (many places open late): sleep in, walk the BGC street-art murals and Burgos Circle, then SM Mall of Asia and its seaside promenade (SM by the Bay) in the late afternoon. Pack for the 2 Jan flight home from Manila.
romantic: Toast the new year at a bayside table at SM by the Bay as the sun sets over Manila Bay.

plan: Land in Tokyo (Narita or Haneda, depending on the airline) after the overnight flights and take the train to Hotel Gracery Shinjuku. It is about 12 °C by day and 4 °C at night, so bring a warm coat. Easy evening: Shibuya Crossing at rush hour, then tsukemen ramen and yakitori in the tiny bars of Omoide Yokocho in Shinjuku. No onsen or bath soaking today.
romantic: Christmas night on the Shibuya Sky open-air rooftop, with the city lights all around (book a night slot).

plan: Morning market tour of the Tsukiji outer market (tamagoyaki, grilled scallops, tuna) and a sushi-making class with a chef. Walk through Ginza, then teamLab Borderless at Azabudai Hills in the afternoon (timed ticket). Izakaya dinner under the train tracks in Yurakucho. No onsen or bath soaking today.
romantic: Tokyo Tower lit up at night, seen from Shiba Park beside Zojo-ji temple.

plan: Asakusa in the morning: Senso-ji temple and Nakamise street snacks (melon pan, ningyo-yaki). Afternoon street go-kart tour through Akihabara and Tokyo Station (an International Driving Permit in the 1949 Geneva format is required), then the Akihabara arcades. Evening street food and izakaya along Ameyoko market in Ueno. About 12 °C, colder on the kart, so wear gloves. No onsen or bath soaking today.
romantic: Dusk walk along the Sumida River with Tokyo Skytree lit up across the water.

plan: Tokyo DisneySea all day (JR to Maihama, about 45 minutes): Fantasy Springs with Anna and Elsa’s Frozen Journey (Premier Access booked in the app), Soaring: Fantastic Flight, Journey to the Center of the Earth, and the Believe! Sea of Dreams night show. Near the water it drops to about 5 °C after dark, so wear layers. No onsen or bath soaking today.
romantic: Gondola-side walk through the Mediterranean Harbor at night, then the Believe! Sea of Dreams show together.

plan: Onsen is allowed from today. Morning at Meiji Jingu shrine and Takeshita Street in Harajuku, then conveyor-belt sushi in Shibuya. Afternoon at teamLab Planets in Toyosu (you walk barefoot through knee-deep water rooms, so roll up your trousers). Evening at Tokyo Toyosu Manyo Club, an onsen with hot-spring water brought from Hakone and Yugawara, then a bowl of ramen.
romantic: The rooftop footbath at Manyo Club, looking over Tokyo Bay at night.

plan: Shinkansen from Tokyo to Kyoto (about 2 hours 15 minutes); leave the bags at Kyoto Station. Day in Kyoto, about 9 °C: Fushimi Inari’s thousands of red gates (walk past the Yotsutsuji crossing, where the crowds thin), lunch at Nishiki Market, Kiyomizu-dera and the lanes of Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka. Evening train to Osaka (about 30 minutes) and check in near Dotonbori, then late takoyaki under the Glico sign.
romantic: Gion at dusk, along the lantern-lit Shirakawa canal and up to Yasaka shrine.

plan: New Year’s Eve. Morning at Kuromon Market for street food (open on 31 Dec, closed from 1 Jan), then kushikatsu in Shinsekai. Warm up and rest at the Spa World onsen next door before the long night. Early toshikoshi soba dinner for luck, then Universal Studios Japan’s NO LIMIT! Countdown 2027 from 19:00: rides at night, the stage show with DJ Zedd, and 5,000 fireworks at midnight. Taxi back to the hotel after the countdown.
romantic: Toshikoshi soba for two, then the midnight countdown and fireworks over the lagoon at Universal Studios Japan.

plan: Late start. First shrine visit of the year (hatsumode) at Sumiyoshi Taisha, about 15 minutes by Nankai train from Namba (very crowded, but lively). Afternoon back in Universal Studios Japan on the same Party Pass (re-entry until 21:00): Super Nintendo World with Mario Kart and Yoshi’s Adventure (get the free Area Timed Entry ticket in the official app), and the Wizarding World of Harry Potter. Many small shops and restaurants close on 1 Jan, but Dotonbori and the park stay open. Pack for the flight home from Kansai airport on 2 Jan.
romantic: Super Nintendo World and Hogwarts castle lit up on the first night of the year.

plan: Land at Beijing Capital after the overnight flight and take the Airport Express and a taxi to the Novotel Beijing Peace near Wangfujing. Cold, about −5 to 3 °C, so wear a down coat, hat and gloves. After a rest, the Forbidden City (book the ticket online a week ahead; closed Mondays) and Jingshan Park for the view over the roofs.
romantic: Sunset over the Forbidden City from Jingshan hill, then Peking duck dinner in Wangfujing.

plan: Universal Beijing Resort all day: Harry Potter, Transformers, Kung Fu Panda and Minion Land. It is about −5 to 3 °C, so dress in layers; Christmas week is busy, so arrive at opening. Metro Line 1 and Line 7 to the Universal Studios line takes about 70 minutes from Wangfujing.
romantic: The castle in the Wizarding World lit up at dusk, with hot chocolate in hand.

plan: Giant pandas first: Beijing Zoo panda house (Metro Line 4, opens 7:30; the pandas are indoors in winter and on view all day, most active at feeding time). Then taxi to the Mutianyu Great Wall: cable car up, walk the watchtowers (steps are icy, wear grip shoes), toboggan down. Cold and windy, about −5 to 3 °C. The wall closes about 17:00, so leave the zoo by 10:00.
romantic: Quiet watchtower walk with the wall winding over the hills.

plan: Morning flight Beijing to Zhangjiajie (about 2 hours 30 minutes), taxi to the Pullman Zhangjiajie. Zhangjiajie can be foggy or icy in late December, about 2 to 10 °C, colder on the peaks; check the cable-car status in the morning. Afternoon at Tianmen Mountain: cable car up, the glass skywalk on the cliff and the Tianmen Cave, back down by sunset (the cable car and skywalk close in strong wind or ice).
romantic: Sunset above the clouds from the Tianmen Mountain cliff walk.

plan: Full day in Zhangjiajie National Forest Park (Wulingyuan): Bailong Elevator, Yuanjiajie’s Avatar Hallelujah Mountain, and the Tianzi Mountain cable car down. The pillars can be fogged in or icy, so wear grip shoes and carry a rain jacket; skip the monkey-heavy Golden Whip Stream. Fog is common; if it clears you see the stone forest, and in fog the pillars appear and vanish.
romantic: Misty stone pillars from the Yuanjiajie viewpoint, with hot tea afterwards.

plan: Morning flight Zhangjiajie to Shanghai (about 2 hours 30 minutes), taxi to the Mercure Shanghai Yuyuan Garden. About 3 to 10 °C. Afternoon at the teamLab slot: teamLab Borderless Shanghai closed in Feb 2024 and teamLab Massless Beijing ended in March 2025, so check teamlab.art in November and swap in an immersive digital art museum in Shanghai if no teamLab is open. Evening on the Bund and a Huangpu river night cruise.
romantic: Walk the Bund at night, with the Pudong skyline across the water.

plan: Shanghai Disneyland all day (Metro Line 11, about 1 hour from the old town; arrive for opening, about 3 to 10 °C, bring layers). Ride Tron, Pirates of the Caribbean and Soaring over the Horizon, and stay for the evening castle fireworks. Metro back and a New Year’s Eve countdown on the Bund or a rooftop bar near Nanjing Road (the Bund can be closed by crowd control, so have the rooftop as plan B).
romantic: Evening fireworks over Enchanted Storybook Castle, then the midnight countdown together.

plan: Slow New Year’s Day: Yu Garden and the old town, a xiaolongbao (soup dumpling) class, then Tianzifang and Xintiandi shopping. Pack for the flight home on 2 Jan (taxi or maglev to Pudong airport on the day, costed here).
romantic: Sunset coffee in Xintiandi on the first evening of the year.

plan: Land in Tokyo (Narita or Haneda, depending on the airline) after the overnight flights and take the train to Hotel Gracery Shinjuku. It is about 17 °C by day and 9 °C at night, so bring a light jacket. 3 Nov is Culture Day, a public holiday, so Shibuya is busier than usual. Easy evening: Shibuya Crossing at rush hour, then tsukemen ramen and yakitori in the tiny bars of Omoide Yokocho in Shinjuku. No onsen or bath soaking today.
romantic: Night on the Shibuya Sky open-air rooftop, with the city lights all around (book a night slot).

plan: Morning market tour of the Tsukiji outer market (tamagoyaki, grilled scallops, tuna) and a sushi-making class with a chef. Walk through Ginza, then teamLab Borderless at Azabudai Hills in the afternoon (timed ticket). Izakaya dinner under the train tracks in Yurakucho. No onsen or bath soaking today.
romantic: Tokyo Tower lit up at night, seen from Shiba Park beside Zojo-ji temple.

plan: Asakusa in the morning: Senso-ji temple and Nakamise street snacks (melon pan, ningyo-yaki). Afternoon street go-kart tour through Akihabara and Tokyo Station (an International Driving Permit in the 1949 Geneva format is required), then the Akihabara arcades. Evening street food and izakaya along Ameyoko market in Ueno. About 17 °C, cooler on the kart, so bring a light jacket. No onsen or bath soaking today.
romantic: Dusk walk along the Sumida River with Tokyo Skytree lit up across the water.

plan: Tokyo DisneySea all day (JR to Maihama, about 45 minutes): Fantasy Springs with Anna and Elsa’s Frozen Journey (Premier Access booked in the app), Soaring: Fantastic Flight, Journey to the Center of the Earth, and the Believe! Sea of Dreams night show. Near the water it drops to about 10 °C after dark, so bring a layer. No onsen or bath soaking today.
romantic: Gondola-side walk through the Mediterranean Harbor at night, then the Believe! Sea of Dreams show together.

plan: Onsen is allowed from today. Morning at Meiji Jingu shrine and Takeshita Street in Harajuku, then conveyor-belt sushi in Shibuya. Afternoon at teamLab Planets in Toyosu (you walk barefoot through knee-deep water rooms, so roll up your trousers). Evening at Tokyo Toyosu Manyo Club, an onsen with hot-spring water brought from Hakone and Yugawara, then a bowl of ramen.
romantic: The rooftop footbath at Manyo Club, looking over Tokyo Bay at night.

plan: Shinkansen from Tokyo to Kyoto (about 2 hours 15 minutes); leave the bags at Kyoto Station. Day in Kyoto, about 18 °C, with the first autumn colours starting: Fushimi Inari’s thousands of red gates (walk past the Yotsutsuji crossing, where the crowds thin), lunch at Nishiki Market, Kiyomizu-dera and the lanes of Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka. Evening train to Osaka (about 30 minutes) and check in near Dotonbori, then late takoyaki under the Glico sign.
romantic: Gion at dusk, along the lantern-lit Shirakawa canal and up to Yasaka shrine.

plan: Morning at Kuromon Market for street food, then kushikatsu in Shinsekai. Warm up and rest at the Spa World onsen next door. Early soba dinner, then Universal Studios Japan from 15:00 on the 1.5-Day Studio Pass (entry from 15:00 today, all day tomorrow): the Wizarding World of Harry Potter and the big rides in the evening, when the queues are shorter on a quiet Monday (check the closing time, usually 20:00 or 21:00 on November weekdays). Train back to Namba after closing.
romantic: Soba for two, then Hogwarts castle and the lagoon lit up at night at Universal Studios Japan.

plan: Late start. Morning visit to Sumiyoshi Taisha, about 15 minutes by Nankai train from Namba; November is Shichi-Go-San season, so you may see families with children in kimono. Afternoon back in Universal Studios Japan on day two of the 1.5-Day Studio Pass: Super Nintendo World with Mario Kart and Yoshi’s Adventure (get the free Area Timed Entry ticket in the official app), and the Wizarding World of Harry Potter. Dinner in the park. Pack for the flight home from Kansai airport on Wed 11 Nov.
romantic: Super Nintendo World and Hogwarts castle lit up on your last night in Japan.

plan: Land at Velana airport and take the Kaani speedboat to Maafushi, about 35 minutes. Rest, then take a short walk through the village lanes and harbour in modest clothes.
romantic: Watch the sunset from Bikini Beach after the long journey.

plan: A beach morning at Bikini Beach, the sandy, shallow swimming area about 40 metres from the hotel. Lunch at a beach café and a slow afternoon.
romantic: Stargazing on the beach after dark, with insect repellent on.

plan: Water sports from the beach with no swimming: a tandem parasail ride plus a jet ski or jet car session with Maafushi Dive. Rest in the afternoon.
romantic: Fly side by side on the tandem parasail.

plan: A slow morning with souvenir shopping in the village. In the late afternoon, the trip’s only boat outing: a dolphin-watching cruise, watching only, no swimming.
romantic: Spot dolphins together from the bow of the boat.

plan: Morning speedboat to the airport and a half-day in Malé: the Old Friday Mosque, Sultan Park, the National Museum and the fish market, with Maldivian short eats for lunch. Afternoon speedboat to Niva Velassaru, 25 minutes.
romantic: Champagne and oysters on the resort beach, a free festive event from 5 to 6 pm.

plan: A wellness day: a couples ritual at the LIME overwater spa, then the Japanese brunch at Sora, the overwater restaurant.
romantic: Cinema Under the Stars, a free outdoor film night at Fen.

plan: A free tennis session in the morning and a quiet afternoon. In the evening, the New Year’s Eve dinner, then the Pure Celestial party on the main beach.
romantic: Count down to midnight barefoot on the sand at the beach party.

plan: Late breakfast, then adopt a coral frame with your names on it through the resort’s marine team. Optional last swim from the sandy main beach before flying home the next day.
romantic: Private candlelit dinner for two in a beach cabana.
